item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Ariana Grande - Dangerous Woman (10th Anniversary Expanded) 22 tracks
item.description:
Hey everyone,
With the recent release of the Tenth Anniversary Edition of Dangerous Woman, I’m looking to see if anyone can share a high-quality copy (preferably FLAC or Apple Lossless, but high-bitrate MP3/M4A is totally fine too!).
I am specifically looking for the Anniversary tracklist but expanded with a few essential bonus tracks, unreleased edits, and acapellas if possible.
Here is what I'm hoping to get:
* **Album:** Dangerous Woman (Tenth Anniversary Edition) [Including Knew Better Part Two]
* **Bonus Tracks Added:**
* Focus
* Side To Side (Solo Version)
* Dangerous Woman (A Capella)
* Into You (A Capella)
If anyone has this put together, or has the individual high-quality files to share so I can compile it, I would appreciate it so much!
Thank you in advance!
